burst_flight.config.fovEffect.tooltip: Whether the field of view widens during a burst
burst_flight.config.fovIncrease.tooltip: How much wider the field of view gets during a burst, in percent. The FOV Effects slider scales it, and Minecraft caps the total widening, sprint and flight included, at 50 percent
burst_flight.config.multiplier.tooltip: Flying speed during a burst, as a multiple of vanilla creative flight; sprinting doubles it as in creative. A player another mod granted its own multiple keeps that one
burst_flight.config.everyone.tooltip: Whether every player may burst-fly; when off, only players another mod allows can
